pokedexEntries.go: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

pokedexEntries.si: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other POKéMON get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

pokedexEntries.cr: The pungent-smelling flame that shoots from its mouth results from toxins burning in its body.

pokedexEntries.rs: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply towards the back serves a leadership role. These POKéMON choose their leader by fighting amongst themselves.

pokedexEntries.em: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

pokedexEntries.dp: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

pokedexEntries.pt: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
